literal: Desire, they say, for all living beings, at all times, is the seed that yields unceasing birth.
translation: Desire, they say, is the seed that yields an endless cycle of births for all living beings at all times.
modern: எல்லா உயிர்களுக்கும் எக்காலத்திலும் அழியாத பிறவித்துன்பத்தைத் தரும் விதை ஆசை என்று கூறுவர்.
explanation: This couplet explains the root cause of the cycle of rebirths. The author identifies 'அவா' (desire) as the primary seed ('வித்து') that continuously generates new births ('பிறப்பு') for all living beings. The word 'தவாஅ' is an elongated form meaning 'unceasing' or 'never-ending', emphasizing that as long as desire exists, the cycle of birth and death will never stop. By calling desire the 'seed', the couplet highlights that just as a seed inevitably grows into a plant, desire inevitably manifests as future existence.
